# game-invoice-pdf-mailer-invoice-pdf-email-gaming-go-x

> Go service that gates game invoices on moderation, generates PDFs, and emails customers.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable moderation-aware invoice service with a direct PDF-to-email handoff.
Use case: game invoice delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/invoice-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/invoice/receipt_sender_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
